_comment: OPEN search, SYMMETRIC -3000/+3000 Da. POSITIVE CONTROL ONLY -- not the primary metric.
SIGN BUG, FIXED 2026-07-23. This was -3000/+1000, which is BACKWARDS for its own purpose.
dm = expmass - calcmass = (z_ours - z_true)(m/z - PROTON), so a 4->2 error (we say 4, truth
is 2) has slope k=+2 and lands at POSITIVE dM: +1398 Da at m/z 700. The old +1000 ceiling
clipped it, leaving 4->2 visible only below m/z 501 -- a sliver of the range. The assay built
to detect 10,199 known 4->2 confusions could not report them.
It could see 2->4 (k=-2, negative dM) perfectly, so a run would return a plausible number and
FALSELY VINDICATE the instrument. Symmetric now: both directions reportable.
This window is expensive and its target-decoy FDR is correspondingly less trustworthy, which
is why entrapment rather than decoy is the FDR estimator here.
